events.summary_en: Since the evening of November 20, Russian forces have attacked five districts of the Dnipropetrovsk region nearly 10 times using drones and missiles. Two people were killed and 55 injured. Children were among both the victims and the injured.

syfte.beskrivning_sv: Taktiskt mål: Neka fienden manöverutrymme och stabilisera frontavsnittet.

niva_vetskap_sannolikhet.motivering_en: High confidence: Corroborated by official Ukrainian emergency services (DSNS) and international wire agencies.
